changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[StorageAccount]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table dbo.StorageAccount ( [Region] char(2) not null constraint CK_StorageAccount_Region CHECK (Region in ('LO', 'AU', 'EU', 'SG', 'UK', 'US')), [EnvironmentLevel] int not null constraint CK_StorageAccount_EnvironmentLevel CHECK (EnvironmentLevel in (0,1,2,3)), [Service] int not null constraint CK_StorageAccount_Service CHECK (Service in (1,2)), -- 1 : Queue , 2 : Storage [ConnectionString] varchar(250) not null, constraint PK_StorageAccount primary key clustered (Region, EnvironmentLevel, [Service]) ) end
